describes: packages/plugin/redaction: the reducer, and estimateCollateral and getPending over a stub context.

cases.name: started-keeps-the-last-result
cases.covers: APPLY_STARTED sets applying and keeps lastResult.

cases.name: finished-with-null-keeps-the-result
cases.covers: A failed apply (result null) clears applying and keeps the previous result.

cases.name: finished-when-idle
cases.covers: APPLY_FINISHED always makes a new state, even when nothing changes.

cases.name: unknown-action
cases.covers: An action outside the union returns the same state.

cases.name: no-document
cases.covers: Without a document there are no pages, so nothing is counted.

cases.name: touching-edges-do-not-count
cases.covers: Intersection needs positive area: shared edges and corners are not collateral.

cases.name: quads-replace-the-rect
cases.covers: A mark with quads targets the quads’ boxes only, not its /Rect.

cases.name: one-annotation-counts-once
cases.covers: An annotation under several marks is one piece of collateral.

cases.name: pages-in-document-order
cases.covers: Only pages in the document are counted, each against its own marks.

cases.name: pending-kinds-ids-and-labels
cases.covers: Each redact annotation becomes a pending item: id from its ref (obj:, nm:, idx:), text kind with quads else area, its overlay label, and the page’s display index (-1 when the page has none).

cases.name: pending-unknown-ref-kind
cases.covers: A ref of any other kind takes the index spelling, with whatever members it has.
